parsed.draft_response:
Hi there—sorry about the trouble getting your new analyst access. Since other users can log in normally but she receives an “access denied” message right after accepting the invite, this likely needs a quick manual look at the workspace access/permissions for her account.

To help us investigate and get it resolved as quickly as possible, could you reply with:
1) The exact wording of the “access denied” message (and any error code/details, if shown).
2) The workspace she’s trying to access (name, and which environment if applicable).
3) The analyst’s email/username.
4) Whether she can log in to the platform at all, or the failure happens only when she selects/opens the workspace.

Once we have that, we’ll escalate internally and work to restore her workspace access today.
promised_actions: Work to restore her workspace access today
safety_notes: Requesting missing details needed to reproduce/verify the exact failure point and workspace association.
Not confirming root cause or guaranteeing a specific fix without reviewing the provided account/workspace details.

parsed.customer_impact: The new analyst cannot access the workspace, blocking their ability to work while other users remain able to log in normally.

missing_information: The exact wording of the 'access denied' message and any error details/code.

The analyst’s account identifier (email/username) and role/permissions assigned in the workspace (if known).
Whether the analyst can log in to the platform at all, or only fails when accessing the workspace.
Whether the invite was resent or whether any changes were made to access settings since the invite was accepted.
Whether this is limited to a specific environment (e.g., production vs. a particular workspace instance) or occurs across all workspaces.
risk_signals: Access denied occurs immediately after invite acceptance for only the new analyst, suggesting a permissions/auth configuration issue affecting account access.
